bdc6383720052e4d.description: About the Role SO/ Hotels & Resorts is seeking an Executive Chef to lead the culinary direction for SO/ Jeddah. This full-time role is based in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. The Executive Chef will be responsible for developing dining experiences, ensuring culinary excellence across all venues, and leading a culinary team while achieving operational and commercial objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the culinary vision and strategy for all restaurants, bars, events, and in-room dining services. Develop innovative and current menus that align with the SO/ brand and local culture. Ensure consistent quality and creativity across all culinary offerings. Mentor and develop the culinary team. Drive culinary innovation by monitoring dining trends and guest preferences. Collaborate with Food & Beverage leadership to create dining experiences that generate revenue. Oversee kitchen operations, productivity, and service standards across all outlets. Manage food costs, inventory, and profitability while maintaining quality. Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and regulatory requirements. Foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement within the culinary team. bd3b3da0c5e4e12f.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مجموعة بن جار الله لإدارة المرافق عن ميكانيكي مصاعد للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية فحص وصيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة والمقاعد الهوائية والأرصفة المتحركة، مما يضمن سلامتها وكفاءتها التشغيلية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد أي أضرار قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو المعطوبة، وإجراء الاختبارات اللازمة للمعدات بعد التصليح لضمان عملها بشكل صحيح. تفكيك المعدات لإجراء التحسينات الأساسية وإعادة تجميعها، وتوفير الأجزاء المطلوبة لإتمام هذه العمليات. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لجميع خدمات وصيانة وتصليحات المعدات. الالتزام الصارم بجميع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال صيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة. معرفة قوية بأنظمة المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة ومكوناتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء التصليحات اللازمة بكفاءة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل ميكانيكي المصاعد ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الحفاظ على أعلى معايير السلامة والجودة في جميع أعمال الصيانة والتصليح. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات فنية ممتازة في التعامل مع المعدات الميكانيكية والكهربائية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في حفظ السجلات والتوثيق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

bd4e2ed8d391470a.description: About Baker Hughes and Gaffney Cline energy advisory (GCea) Baker Hughes is an energy technology company with operations in over 120 countries, focused on delivering innovative technologies and services across the energy value chain. Gaffney Cline energy advisory (GCea), a segment within Baker Hughes, provides technical, commercial, and strategic advice to the petroleum sector. GCea specializes in the business of petroleum, with expertise in exploration, development, production evaluation, field development, formation evaluation, wellbore analysis, economic analysis, and production optimization. The Role of Petrophysicist Advisor Baker Hughes is seeking a Petrophysicist Advisor with over 15 years of experience to join the Gaffney Cline energy advisory team. This full-time role involves providing specialized expertise in formation evaluation and reservoir engineering for multidisciplinary projects. The advisor will integrate various subsurface data to assess reservoir potential, optimize hydrocarbon recovery, and provide strategic advice to clients. Key Responsibilities Provide formation evaluation and reservoir engineering expertise for projects including field development planning, reservoir characterization, and performance analysis. Integrate petrophysical, geological, and reservoir engineering data to evaluate reservoir potential and optimize hydrocarbon recovery. Conduct advanced formation evaluation studies, including log interpretation, petrophysical analysis, saturation evaluation, net pay determination, and reservoir quality assessment. Apply reservoir engineering techniques such as reservoir simulation, material balance analysis, decline curve analysis, and production forecasting. Present technical data, interpretations, recommendations, and reports to clients, either independently or as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Advise clients on formation evaluation, petrophysics, reservoir management, field development, and production optimization strategies. Support mentoring, coaching, and technical training activities for junior engineers and petrophysicists. Lead large multidisciplinary project teams and manage multiple projects of varying scope and complexity. Support business development activities, technical proposal preparation, and client engagement initiatives. Required Qualifications and Experience Work authorization in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is required. Over 10 years of experience in petrophysics and reservoir engineering. Strong understanding of integrated subsurface workflows, combining geology, geophysics, petrophysics, formation evaluation, and reservoir engineering data. Hands-on experience with Baker Hughes and industry-standard software applications for Formation Evaluation and Reservoir Engineering, or other applicable industry software platforms. Experience leading integrated studies and collaborating across Reservoir Engineering, Petrophysics, Geology, Geophysics, Drilling, and Production disciplines. Strong understanding of unconventional and conventional reservoir evaluation methodologies and reservoir management practices. Experience supporting reservoir characterization, formation evaluation, field development, reserves assessment, and production enhancement projects. Key Skills and Attributes Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively within multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams. Highly motivated with strong analytical, technical, and leadership skills. Experience in managing multidisciplinary technical teams and mentoring professionals. Advanced project management and stakeholder management skills. Strong planning, organizational, and time-management abilities. Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality technical solutions. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements and are authorized to work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia are encouraged to apply for this full-time Petrophysicist Advisor position.

This involves building meaningful emotional connections with customers and communities, supporting business objectives, and enhancing the long-term value and reputation of the Lexus brand in the region. This includes integrating future product launches, lifecycle priorities, and key brand initiatives. bdc19e57a0c9c6f1.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking an experienced Head of Product, Agile Delivery & Transformation to lead a large-scale digital transformation program for a prominent organization in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Jeddah or Makkah and requires a leader capable of driving end-to-end transformation planning, establishing Agile squads, and overseeing product delivery to align business strategy with technology and execution. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Develop and manage integrated transformation roadmaps across Business, Data, AI, Cloud Migration, Experience Design, and Software Development. Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and critical program decisions. Establish and manage cross-functional Agile squad operating models. Drive product strategy, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, and release management. Oversee the complete product lifecycle, from discovery and design to development, deployment, and continuous improvement. Ensure alignment between Product, Engineering, UX/UI, QA, and Business teams. Promote outcome-driven Agile practices and predictable delivery. Establish and lead high-performing cross-functional squads and dedicated SWAT teams for critical initiatives. Define squad responsibilities, delivery processes, governance structures, and performance measures. Resolve delivery bottlenecks and improve collaboration across workstreams. Establish transformation governance frameworks, reporting structures, and accountability models. Define milestone-based SLAs, delivery expectations, and escalation procedures. Monitor program progress, delivery performance, risks, and dependencies. Provide executive-level reporting on transformation progress, milestones, and business outcomes. Collaborate with senior business and technology leadership to align transformation priorities. Drive organizational adoption of Agile methodologies and modern product delivery practices. Facilitate strategic decision-making and resolve cross-functional challenges. Build a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a strategic yet hands-on transformation leader capable of translating business vision into structured execution. This role requires a combination of strong product thinking, enterprise-level Agile delivery, technical understanding, and executive stakeholder management to drive measurable business and customer outcomes. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in enterprise digital transformation, product strategy, Agile delivery, program governance, and technology modernization. Demonstrated leadership experience in large-scale digital transformation programs. Proficiency in establishing and managing cross-functional Agile operating models. Experience in driving product strategy, roadmap development, and backlog prioritization. Ability to establish transformation governance frameworks and accountability models. Strong stakeholder management and change management capabilities. Work Location This position is a full-time role located in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah.

bde4a6b9b778a466.description: About BKN301 BKN301 is a financial technology group that designs fintech solutions for banks, fintechs, and merchants across emerging markets. Based in London, with offices in Milan, Doha, and San Marino, the company is expanding its international presence. BKN301 focuses on turning ideas into scalable fintech solutions through collaboration and diverse expertise. Role Overview BKN301 is seeking a Business Development Manager, Real Estate Tokenization to lead commercial expansion in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves selling real estate tokenization solutions to top-tier real estate developers, asset managers, private equity funds, and family offices. The manager will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to deal closure, and for building strategic relationships within the Kingdom's real estate and digital asset ecosystem, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Identify, target, and acquire new clients, including real estate developers, fund managers, REITs, family offices, and institutional investors interested in fractionalizing, digitizing, or raising capital on real estate assets. Manage the full sales cycle, encompassing outreach, consultative pitching, contract negotiation, and closing deals. Present tokenization solutions to C-level executives, detailing the legal and regulatory framework, liquidity benefits, and secondary market trading capabilities. Establish strategic partnerships with local financial advisory firms, law firms, proptech networks, and relevant regulatory and industry stakeholders. Monitor trends within the Middle East real estate sector, Vision 2030 giga-projects, and the evolving local digital asset regulation. Provide market and client insights to inform BKN301's commercial strategy and offering. Work Environment and Benefits This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to building BKN301's presence in the Kingdom and to engage in growth and learning within an innovative group. The company fosters an international culture built on trust and collaboration. A competitive, market-aligned compensation package will be provided. Equal Opportunity Employer BKN301 is an equal opportunity employer that values diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences. Applications from all qualified candidates are welcome, as the company believes in the strength derived from different perspectives.

bdd1eb165fe9e4dd.description: About Bristol-Myers Squibb Bristol Myers Squibb is dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines to address serious diseases. The company fosters a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits, offering work that transforms patients' lives and employees' careers. Role Overview: Field Access Manager - MOH Based in Riyadh, the Field Access Manager - MOH will report to the Director – Market Access and Government Affairs, Saudi Arabia & Gulf Countries. This full-time role involves managing relationships with clinical pharmacies in hospitals and institutions, NUPCO, and Central Medical Supplies at the Ministry of Health (MoH). The manager will work closely with distributors to facilitate the timely completion and execution of NUPCO contracts at the account level, including quantity calculations, tender awards, delivery schedules, purchase order preparation, and consumption monitoring. The role also includes monitoring product stocks across the Saudi Arabian supply chain and implementing market access plans, with a focus on optimizing Months of Inventory (MOI) for all SKUs in collaboration with Strategic Access colleagues, Finance, Supply Chain, and distributors. This position will lead the tenders taskforce with all franchise teams on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis. Key Responsibilities Analyze and interpret government policies and strategies related to medicine access, health economic assessment policies, and pharmaceutical spending trends, in cooperation with Market Access and Government Affairs leads. Ensure full compliance with laws, regulations, and BMS Standards of Business Conduct and Ethics. Establish and maintain close relationships with distributors, institutions, clusters, NUPCO, and the MoH. Participate in strategic access discussions and assist in developing strategic access plans for all products. Encourage and support cross-functional collaboration within the organization. Facilitate the timely completion and execution of NUPCO awards and contracts, including account purchase order issuance. Monitor market and account needs, monthly consumption, and stock levels. Serve as the main point of contact for any supply or stock-related issues at the account level. Lead on-ground efforts to implement strategic access plans and ensure enlistment timelines are met. Regularly update the Cross-Functional Team (CFT) on Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committees’ status and schedules. Coach Therapeutic Area Partners (TAPs) on the process of Special Patient Requests (SPRs) and enlistment across all accounts and institutions in Saudi Arabia. Assist in developing monitoring dashboards and ensure timely data feeding for up-to-date information. Conduct regular joint visits with TAPs to resolve access-related issues. Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the healthcare environment, trends, and potential emerging segments, proposing strategies to establish BMS as a partner of choice. Disseminate information promptly to senior management to support effective decision-making. Stay informed of environmental changes, communicate, and constantly interact with Franchise Teams to drive competitive advantage. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. The position involves regular interactions with cross-functional BMS teams (Franchise Teams, Access and Government Affairs, Medical, Regulatory), distributors, pharmacy, planning, and purchasing departments at institutions and health clusters, Central Medical Supplies, regional ministry branches at MoH, NUPCO, and key private accounts. Required Skills Superior communication and negotiation skills are essential. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

bd38edee11b6c847.description: About كيلوج براون اند روت كيلوج براون اند روت is a company driven by innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers, all united by the goal of improving the world responsibly and safely. The company fosters a diverse workforce and attracts top talent by valuing creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. Role Overview كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking an Insulator (II), Lead to join their team. This full-time role involves supervising insulation activities, specifically the removal and repair of both hot and cold insulation on industrial equipment. The position requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in Oil & Gas maintenance. Key Responsibilities Apply, remove, and repair insulation on industrial equipment, pipes, ductwork, and other mechanical systems within SATORP Plants. Determine the necessary amounts and types of insulation, as well as installation methods, based on factors such as location, surface shape, and equipment use. Install sheet metal around insulated pipes using screws to protect the insulation from weather conditions or physical damage. Prepare surfaces for insulation application by brushing or spreading adhesives. Select appropriate insulation materials, such as fiberglass, Styrofoam, or cork, based on their heat retaining or excluding characteristics. Adhere to all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) rules and regulations. Possess proper knowledge of plant hazardous materials. Demonstrate proper knowledge of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and its correct use. Qualifications and Experience High School diploma. Minimum of 5 years of experience in Oil & Gas maintenance.

This includes world-class licensed process technologies, specialized advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions designed to optimize planned and operating assets. bda6d5dc784156bb.description: About Sephora and the Role Sephora is seeking a Store & Workplace Support Tech Lead to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring stable, secure, and high-performing store technology operations across the region. The successful candidate will have over 10 years of experience in IT support or store technology, preferably within a retail or multi-site environment. Role Overview The Store & Workplace Support Tech Lead is responsible for providing remote and in-field technology support for Sephora stores. This includes expertise in store infrastructure, network connectivity, POS hardware, payment terminals, back-office equipment, and store-specific applications. The role supports store openings, renovations, hardware refreshes, incident resolution, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, vendor coordination, and business continuity activities. The Tech Lead will collaborate with local IT teams in KSA and Dubai, external vendors, EME infrastructure teams, and retail stakeholders in KSA. Key Responsibilities Provide technology leadership, building and coaching the KSA team, and setting key objectives for stores and workplace technology. Manage local tech requirements and plan deployments with the team, aligning KSA team strategies with ME Tech management goals. Ensure knowledge transfer across workplace and store technologies, holding regular checkpoints and team meetings. Manage relationships with external vendors, including hardware expense management, negotiations, and stock management for business continuity. Oversee relationship management with EME and LVMH teams regarding EUX topics. Adhere to relevant IT policies, processes, and standard operating procedures in line with LVMH group and Sephora global rules. Set up dashboards, metrics, and measure the Quality of Service (QoS) of external partners, following up on SLA/SLO and applying penalties as needed. Provide remote and in-field support for store operations, back-office users, POS areas, and Apple/Microsoft devices, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Support retail store technology, including POS terminals, payment devices, network infrastructure, and digital in-store tools. Coordinate with technical services, network, security, application, and vendor teams to troubleshoot connectivity, POS availability, and critical outages. Support store opening, closure, relocation, and renovation activities, ensuring infrastructure readiness and device testing. Perform on-site validation of store technology environments to ensure adherence to Sephora and LVMH standards. Administer and maintain IT assets, including routine maintenance, performance monitoring, and configuration of hardware and software. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of proven experience in IT support or store technology operations, preferably within a retail, hospitality, or multi-site environment. Strong understanding of retail store operations, POS environments, store networks, infrastructure dependencies, and the impact of technology availability on client experience and business continuity. Solid knowledge of store infrastructure, LAN/WAN connectivity, switching, wireless networks, structured cabling, network troubleshooting, O365, Microsoft endpoint environments, basic security controls, and ITIL practices. Ability to analyze, synthesize information, and adapt to change. Effective communication skills for various stakeholders at the EME level, including IT and business. Strong knowledge of procurement and purchasing processes in the ME region, with logistics (export & import processes) being an advantage. Required Skills and Attributes Self-starter with the ability to drive topics to deliver business value. Capable of acting as a reliable IT business partner, focusing on end-user satisfaction. "Hands-on" approach with the ability to operationally contribute to project success. Problem-solving oriented mindset. "End-users" and "service quality" oriented. Comfortable working within a matrix organization. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with local IT teams, external vendors, and regional stakeholders to maintain high standards of technology support across Sephora's retail network.

bd63cddfc2066caa.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Senior Specialist, Cost Accounting to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for supporting product costing, inventory valuation, and manufacturing finance activities. The specialist will contribute to accurate cost information, inventory valuation, and operational decision-making, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and company policies. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to manage cost analysis, inventory accounting, variance reporting, and financial reporting processes. This involves maintaining product cost structures and supporting various financial closing activities to ensure the integrity of cost data and inventory valuation. Key Responsibilities Maintain product cost structures, Bills of Materials (BOMs), routings, and standard costing information within approved systems and processes. Perform product costing activities, cost roll-ups, and standard cost updates to support accurate costing and inventory valuation. Analyze direct material, labor, and manufacturing overhead costs, and support cost estimate development for products and manufacturing activities. Perform manufacturing variance analysis, including material, labor, overhead, and inventory variances, and investigate significant deviations. Support inventory valuation activities, inventory reconciliations, inventory provision assessments, and cycle count reviews. Monitor inventory movements, write-offs, slow-moving inventory, and obsolete inventory, providing analysis and recommendations where required. Support month-end and year-end closing activities through preparation of reconciliations, journal entries, schedules, and costing analyses. Prepare cost, inventory, margin, and profitability reports to support operational and financial performance reviews. Ensure compliance with IFRS, company accounting policies, and internal controls related to costing and inventory accounting. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Finance teams to support costing activities, process improvements, and business initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in cost accounting or a related financial role. A strong understanding of accounting standards and internal controls is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring collaboration with various internal departments to achieve financial objectives and operational efficiency. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

bd0b88df202fa88f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الإنشاءات السعودية عن فني شبكات اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم مشاريع الصيانة والتشغيل والنظافة لمباني وكالة البلديات ومراكز مدينتي التابعة لأمانة منطقة الرياض. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال شبكات الاتصالات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات اللازمة لتشغيل الشبكات بكفاءة. ضمان التشغيل السليم لخدمات الهواتف والإنترنت وتوصيل كافة الأسلاك داخل المباني وخارجها. إعداد التقارير الدورية للمسؤول المباشر حول حالة الشبكات والأعمال المنجزة. متابعة وحل مشاكل الشبكة تحت إشراف مهندس الشبكة. صيانة معدات وأدوات الصيانة الروتينية وتحديد نوع الصيانة اللازمة وتوقيتها. اختبار المعدات التي تم إصلاحها أو تثبيتها حديثًا أو تحديثها لضمان عملها بشكل صحيح ومطابقتها للمواصفات. اختبار الدوائر ومكونات معدات الاتصالات السلكية واللاسلكية المعطلة لتحديد مصادر الأعطال وإصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال شبكات الاتصالات. معرفة بأنظمة الإرسال والبث والتبديل والتحكم في تشغيل أنظمة الاتصالات. القدرة على العمل ضمن مشاريع صيانة وتشغيل ونظافة المباني. بيئة العمل يعمل فني شبكات الاتصالات ضمن فريق في مشاريع صيانة وتشغيل ونظافة مباني وكالة البلديات ومراكز مدينتي التابعة لأمانة منطقة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

bda9d8e52f09ee99.description: About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for serious diseases. The company is undergoing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, aiming to advance healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. This involves investments in talent, digital solutions, and new operational methods to enhance patient outcomes and reinforce leadership in therapeutic areas. Product Specialist Rare Disease AstraZeneca is seeking a Product Specialist Rare Disease to join its Commercial Team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for establishing the company's position as a leader in Rare Disease. The Product Specialist will be responsible for generating clinical demand for rare disease medicines, identifying business opportunities, and developing relationships with opinion leaders and healthcare professionals (HCPs). The role requires 2-5 years of experience and reports directly to the Sales Manager. Key Responsibilities Engage HCPs to promote knowledge of rare disease medicines, including value propositions, approved indications, efficacy/safety profiles, and treatment protocols, using science-driven messages and appropriate channels. Proactively identify new patient targets and achieve or exceed sales objectives within the assigned region, including accurate and timely reporting of sales activities. Demonstrate in-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge in relevant disease states and product mechanisms of action. Improve patient identification and diagnosis, and manage market development objectives, strategies, tactics, and action plans within the territory. Increase disease awareness among key target groups and work with HCPs to identify and test high-risk patients. Establish and develop a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) network within the territory. Liaise with cross-functional medical, marketing, market access, and diagnostic teams to foster long-term relationships with KOLs, HCP accounts, and other stakeholders. Organize workshops and educational events to facilitate knowledge sharing among relevant HCPs. Collaborate with the Sales Manager to develop and implement strategies and actions to meet promotional objectives. Manage allocated budgets and share insights to strengthen brand positioning and access to treatment. Ensure optimal utilization of rare disease products in line with national/local guidelines and product licenses. Maintain high ethical standards and ensure compliance with the Code of Conduct, supporting Policies and Standards, and Company Values. Required Qualifications and Experience University degree, preferably in Medical Sciences or Pharmacy. 2-5 years of experience in pharmaceuticals, with a preference for haematology/oncology, nephrology, rare disease, and/or critical care specialties. Proven track record of delivering consistent sales results. Strong influencing skills to engage key stakeholders in complex clinical environments, including mid and senior-level specialty care professionals and key accounts. Minimum of 2 years of experience in the hospital business, preferably in niche markets or orphan drugs. Experience working with an overall rare disease portfolio is preferred. Experience in project management. Skills and Attributes Passion for science and commitment to making a positive personal impact. Curiosity and learning agility. Proactive and solution-oriented with strong analytical skills. Collaborative and inclusive approach. High ethical standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a high-performing team focused on driving change and identifying market opportunities. AstraZeneca fosters an inclusive culture that champions diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and development.

bd60596f5a61927a.description: نبحث عن باريستا شغوف ومبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحضير مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة عالية الجودة وتقديم تجربة استثنائية لعملائنا. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وشغفاً بعالم القهوة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام الرئيسية: * تحضير مشروبات الإسبريسو والقهوة المتخصصة بدقة واحترافية. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وفعالة، والإجابة على استفسارات العملاء. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل والمعدات. * المساهمة في تطوير قائمة المشروبات وتقديم أفكار جديدة.

bd7774658d8d7793.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة وتنسيق أنشطتهم، مع التركيز على تحسين الأداء وتطوير إجراءات العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم وأولويات العمل وقدرات الموظفين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة لضمان التكامل. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الخدمات العامة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في تطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل ديناميكي في شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات. تتيح الفرصة للمساهمة في تحسين كفاءة العمليات ورفع مستوى الخدمات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

bd92c0d795f5f6bf.description: About Yokogawa Yokogawa is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems, and industrial services across various industries. Key Responsibilities Deliver prompt technical support for Yokogawa Centum VP system, ProSafe-RS, and PRM. Execute on-site commissioning, start-up assistance, and emergency support. Manage inquiries, troubleshoot, investigate, analyze, test, and resolve issues reported from client sites. Participate in add-on/expansion service projects during engineering, FAT, SAT, and commissioning phases. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on Yokogawa's product portfolio, including hardware and software modifications and upgrades. Implement system modifications and enhancements, both online and offline, as required. Maintain customer satisfaction metrics, ensure optimal process uptime, and enhance system performance. bdd5616eca9ad477.description: About the Role Kinan is seeking a Manager Financial Planning and Analysis to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. bd9ac5db48fa660b.description: About the Role RAWAJ, a leading Saudi retail company operating across e-commerce and retail distribution, is seeking a Marketing Director - Retail & E-Commerce to join their team in Riyadh. Establishing robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from early design stages. Taking ownership of the overall project program, with a focus on establishing, controlling, and maintaining the design program. Coordinating with PMC design managers, architects, design consultants, specialist consultants, and the wider multidisciplinary project team to achieve design deliverables against key milestones. Managing the integration of design, approvals, procurement, and construction programs to maintain a clear route to delivery. Supporting and coordinating the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support required commercial launch dates. Developing and maintaining the project execution plan, master program, risk register, governance structure, and project reporting requirements. Managing procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, program, and project risk. Transitioning the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintaining continuity of project leadership throughout delivery. Managing consultants, contractors, and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against program, cost, quality, and contractual requirements. Monitoring project performance, identifying emerging risks, and implementing recovery or mitigation measures where required. Providing clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on program, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions, and delivery status. Maintaining stakeholder relationships and fostering strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement, and construction teams. Maintaining strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions. Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project. Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover. Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programs and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones. Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement, and physical delivery. Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors, and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments. Strong program management skills with experience identifying program risk, challenging consultant performance, and implementing recovery strategies. Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk, and change-management experience. Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny. bd116e9b0249cdea.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة Bullivant Arabia LTD. عن مهندس صحة وسلامة وبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية ومتوافقة مع المعايير البيئية، من خلال تطوير وتنفيذ برامج السلامة وإدارة المخاطر. الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنة وثلاث سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تثقيف العمال وتقديم الإرشادات والتوجيهات المناسبة قبل بدء العمل. قياس المخاطر البيئية للمنشأة ووضع خطط لتفاديها. تطوير برامج السلامة وفقاً للمعايير الدولية وضمان تنفيذها في الوقت المناسب. التعاون مع المشرفين لفهم طبيعة الأنشطة اليومية. توفير بيئة عمل آمنة من خلال وضع وتنفيذ برامج الصحة والسلامة. التحقيق في الأفعال والمواقف غير الآمنة واتخاذ التدابير اللازمة لمنع تكرارها. تحديد المناطق الخطرة باستخدام ملصقات السلامة ومضات الخطر والمواد الترويجية لحملات السلامة. تفسير اللوائح البيئية ووضع خطط لإجراءات التحسين. تطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع البيئية التي تركز على إدارة النفايات وتقليل الأضرار. تسهيل تحليل السبب الجذري في حالات الطوارئ وإنشاء تقارير لتوثيق الإجراءات. دمج عمليات وممارسات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في العمليات اليومية. المشاركة في أنشطة الصحة والسلامة الروتينية، بما في ذلك الإجراءات التصحيحية والتحقيقات ومراجعات الموقع. التخطيط ووضع تصاريح للعمل الآمن. التأكد من تعيين الموظف المؤهل لمزاولة العمل. ضمان استخدام أدوات ومعدات ذات جودة معتمدة. التأكد من تكامل المعدات، خاصة أدوات السلامة، قبل بدء العمل. الحرص على تكامل معدات الوقاية والحماية من الحرائق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنة وثلاث سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. حاصل على شهادات معتمدة، محلية أو عالمية، مثل NEBOSH أو IOSH أو شهادات مماثلة. مسجل كعضو في هيئة المهندسين. موقع العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة في مدينة جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه تقديم طلباتهم.

bd55b3940344be10.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Head Chef / Head Pastry Chef) Compensation: 7,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. You will take ownership of daily production—ranging from delicate viennoiserie to refined plated desserts—while maintaining uncompromising quality, developing the junior team, and confidently stepping up to lead the section when needed. bdeed1dad4860488.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن ميكانيكي كهرباء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح المعدات الكهربائية المتنوعة، بما في ذلك الآلات والمحركات والمولدات والمفاتيح الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال ذي الصلة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب الآلات والمعدات والنظم الكهربائية المختلفة. فحص أداء المعدات بعد تركيبها ومعاينتها لضمان التزامها بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية لقطع الغيار للتأكد من خلوها من الأضرار أو التلفيات الخطرة، والعمل على تصليح النظم وتحديثها عند الحاجة. التحقيق في الأعطال، وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات، وتشخيص المكونات المعيبة، ثم تصليحها أو استبدالها، ومتابعة الأعمال المنجزة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا الكهرباء أو مجال مشابه. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح مجموعة واسعة من المعدات الكهربائية. فهم جيد للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية المتعلقة بالتركيبات الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإيجاد الحلول الفعالة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يعمل الميكانيكي الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات، ويسهم في ضمان كفاءة وسلامة المعدات الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

bdfea17b80c00aed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصلي الفندقية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، ووضع معايير الأداء، وتحليل رضا العملاء لضمان تقديم تجربة متميزة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتعاون مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعتها باستمرار. المشاركة في صياغة وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما يشمل تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات تهدف إلى تجاوز توقعات العملاء من حيث جودة واحترافية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، لبناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل البيانات والمعلومات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتقييم نتائج رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف. القدرة على تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتحسين الجودة. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات رضا العملاء. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة مصلي الفندقية.

bd7311cc434774d7.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Project EHS Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of Environment, Health, and Safety for construction projects. Key Responsibilities Establish, monitor, appraise, and coordinate an integrated health, safety, and environment management system (conforming to ISO-45001:2018, ISO14001:2015, and ISO 9001 standards) for construction projects. Improvise procedure manuals and conduct internal audits based on established standards. Conduct training programs on EHS topics for engineers and workers on-site, as well as participate in HR-organized EHS training programs. Perform Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment for critical activities, ensuring findings are incorporated into method statements. Prepare EHS Plans and Environment Management Plans. Coordinate External EHS Audits and Third-Party Inspections of Equipment. Prepare Emergency Preparedness Plans and conduct Emergency Drills. Facilitate the implementation of the Work Permit System. Coordinate Occupational Health & Welfare measures. Prepare EHS conditions of contract for sub-contractors. Stop work if unsafe practices are witnessed and promote a proactive safety attitude. Carry out project risk management audits monthly and system audits quarterly. Provide EHS reports to project and IC heads to inform them of current EHS performance status. Daily Duties and EHS Oversight Prepare all EHS-related documents, including EHS plans, emergency response plans, and risk assessments. Lead all EHS meetings with clients and the project team. Report all EHS-related issues to the Head Office. Provide EHS induction training to new workers. Conduct daily EHS inspections for the assigned zone. Ensure appropriate safe work permits are obtained by Engineers/Supervisors from Clients/Main Contractors. Conduct risk assessments throughout the site and inform Site Engineers and/or Clients/Main Contractors of high-risk areas. Ensure toolbox talks are properly delivered by Engineers weekly to foster EHS awareness among workers. Ensure all personnel wear personal protective equipment, including helmets, EHS shoes, and coveralls. Ensure equipment such as ladders and scaffolding are in good working condition before use. Ensure satisfactory health and hygiene conditions for workers, including the availability of water, rest areas, and adequate lighting & ventilation. Ensure proper housekeeping on the project site to prevent incidents/accidents. Conduct Job EHS Analysis on high-risk activities to minimize hazardous conditions. Encourage workers and engineers to implement EHS practices. Conduct investigations with engineers in case of minor or major incidents/accidents. Maintain all documentation related to EHS activities. Qualifications and Experience Must be an ARAMCO-approved EHS Manager. Demonstrated experience in the Oil and Gas sector. A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on construction projects within the Oil and Gas industry.
